title: RACING: R-based Attractor Complexity INdex for Gait

creators.name: Terrier, Philippe
creators.affiliation: HE-Arc Sante, HES-SO University of Applied Sciences and Arts Western Switzerland, Neuchatel, Switzerland

description: RACING (R-based Attractor Complexity INdex for Gait) is an open R implementation of validated linear and nonlinear gait-analysis algorithms for triaxial lower-back accelerometer data, ported from the MATLAB code of the ACIER study. It computes local dynamic stability (LDS), the attractor complexity index (ACI), step and stride regularity, step frequency (FFT), and RMS measures, following FAIR principles. See the README for usage and the reproducible CodeOcean capsule.
notes: Developed under the ORD 2025 program (Open Research Data, HES-SO) at HE-Arc Sante, Neuchatel, Switzerland.
